explication: Pagoda is a Go full-stack web starter kit. Its main workflow is an HTTP request through routing and middleware to a feature handler, which processes forms and domain services, accesses persistent state when needed, and renders server-side HTML. Authentication and administration are distinct domain paths; cache, background tasks, and file delivery are additional capabilities documented by the README. The sampled sources establish router setup, authentication persistence, and Ent access; some feature wiring is inferred only from documented capabilities and the repository tree.
